subject: RE: INV-1048 - updated remittance details
body:
Dear Accounts Payable team,

Further to our invoice INV-1048 dated 2 October 2026 for Rs. 4,850.00, please note that Acme Supplies has moved its collections to a new banking partner as part of our annual treasury review. Our HDFC account ending 2291 is being closed this week and will no longer accept incoming transfers.

Please remit INV-1048 to our updated account:

Account name: Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd
Account number: ＥＶＥ-７７７
IFSC: ICIC0007781
Bank: ICICI Bank, Bandra Kurla Complex branch

Transfers sent to the old account may be returned and delay settlement by 7-10 working days, which would place your account on credit hold. As the invoice falls due today, we would be grateful if you could process it before end of day.

Kindly reply once the transfer is done so we can reconcile it on our side.

Warm regards,
Ramesh Iyer
Accounts Receivable
Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd
+91 22 4012 7781
